description: Fetch a Sulvo report (read-only). Requires SULVO_API_KEY in the server environment (a publisher generates it in the dashboard: Account Settings -> API key). Covers by-date, by-date-and-ad-unit, by-domain-and-ad-unit, bot-filtering, bot-scores, invalid-activity, direct-bidder-analysis, and ad-units-by-domain.

adRoots.description: Filter to these ad unit roots.

directBidder.description: Required for direct-bidder-analysis: the bidder name.

start.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO). Required by most date-bounded reports.

name: get_sulvo_report
